intro: WebM to MP4 converts your WebM videos into MP4. MP4 is the video format that almost everything opens: TVs, phones, video editors, social networks and presentations. If a WebM downloaded from the web does not open in your program, turning it into MP4 usually solves it.

First the tool checks which codecs the video carries. A WebM with AV1 and Opus fits in MP4 and is remuxed without re-encoding. With VP9 or VP8 the picture is re-encoded; Opus sound is kept and Vorbis becomes AAC. When no re-encoding is needed, the conversion takes seconds even if the video lasts an hour, and the picture and sound are identical to the original.

When an WebM needs re-encoding to MP4, H.264 is used if the server has it enabled; otherwise AV1, a modern free codec that plays in browsers, Windows 10 and 11, Android and recent Macs and iPhones. The result note says which one was used. Global file metadata, such as the date, GPS location or the app that recorded it, is removed so you do not share more than you want.

Converting WebM to MP4 is part of the Pro plan: videos up to one hour and 1 GB, up to five at a time, with a ZIP of all of them at the end. They are processed on our server in the European Union and deleted automatically when they expire.
steps: Upload one or more WebM videos.
Press convert: it is copied or re-encoded depending on the codecs.
Download the MP4 or the ZIP with all of them.
